description: Top cloud hyperscalers decelerate infrastructure capex expansion, curbing third-party off-take and GPU hardware orders.
Anchor customer (Microsoft) reduces compute off-take or transitions workloads to internal custom silicon (Maia).
Secondary market clearing prices for H100/H200 fleets fall 40%, triggering margin calls on asset-backed debt facilities.
Private credit syndicated debt markets tighten; borrowing rates rise 300 bps, reducing debt service coverage below 1.0x.
MISO substation delivery at Polaris Forge 1 is delayed 12 months, halting lease revenue commencement while carrying costs run.
Uncontracted GPU capacity spot utilization drops from 85% to 60%, eliminating operator operating cash flow buffer.
